module: Flowgraph node "DOF" (default category, tags gfx/dof). Fades in (blurIn) or out (blurOut) a depth-of-field blur over fadeTime seconds (default 1) by driving the variables $DOFPostFx::BlurMin, BlurMax, BlurCurveFar (target 430) and FocusRangeMax (3), then refreshes DOFPostEffect. Output blurDone when the fade is finished. The original values are saved and restored on reset or stop.
notes: The savedBlurMin/Max/... backups are read then rewritten on every mode change, without being reset to nil.

reset.desc: Resets the timer and the mode to zero and restores the saved DOF variables.

updateSettings.desc: Calls DOFPostEffect.updateDOFSettings() if the effect exists.

work.desc: Detects the mode (in/out), saves the DOF settings then advances the fade with dtSim; sets blurDone to true at the end.
